name: viewer
description: Time-series 3D point dataset viewer. Increment 1: render frame 0 of a synthetic dataset in a CSP-safe webview.

molaro.assistant.model.description: Anthropic model the analysis assistant uses.

molaro.modsDir.description: Directory where mods (*.py) are stored, loaded from, and saved to. A leading ~ expands to your home directory. Empty (the default) means the global ~/.molaro/mods, shared across all workspaces. The directory is created on first use.

molaro.assistant.useStub.description: Use the scripted stub backend instead of the real Claude Agent SDK assistant (no network, no API key). For development and the test suite.

molaro.viewer.depthVariant.description: Impostor depth path: 1 = flat sprite depth (early-Z preserved), 2 = analytic per-fragment depth (correct interpenetration — required for real oriented geometry such as the ribbon to compose with sprites). Default 2, an architectural call made without hardware measurement; set 1 if frame rate matters more than crossing correctness on your hardware. Takes effect when a viewer panel is (re)opened.

molaro.viewer.holdCommand.markdownDescription: Command run when the hold key is held over a point in the viewer. `{target}` is replaced by the resolved committed selection (`@name`). Empty disables the gesture. The command runs through the ordinary command path — pre-validated, one undo stroke.

molaro.viewer.maxFrames.markdownDescription: How many trajectory frames to LOAD from a real dataset. A longer trajectory is loaded with a stride — every `ceil(frames/cap)`-th frame — which keeps the frame count, and every per-frame channel a mod produces from it, bounded however long the run was; the header's provenance then names the stride and the true frame count. `0` (the default) uses the producer's built-in cap of 500 frames. A positive number caps at that many. A negative number loads **every** frame — correct for short trajectories, but a 15 000-frame system then makes a per-point per-frame vector channel of `frames x atoms x 3 x 4` bytes (2.33 GB on a 12 944-atom system), which will not fit. Takes effect when a viewer panel is (re)opened.

enumDescriptions: Infer every missing bond, solvent included.
Infer missing bonds, but skip solvent residues.
Draw only the bonds the topology declares.
molaro.viewer.inferBonds.markdownDescription: Whether to INFER the covalent bonds a topology does not declare. Many real files leave connectivity out: a PDB with no `CONECT` records shows every ligand and lipid as loose dust (the 222 227-atom membrane system: 482 DMPC lipids, 56 876 atoms, fully unbonded), and mdtraj's residue templates never bond nucleic `O3'-P`, so **every** nucleic backbone arrives unlinked. `full` (the default) fills those in from Cordero covalent radii, scoped to within one residue, to the named backbone linkage between sequence-adjacent residues (protein `C-N`, nucleic `O3'-P`), and to S/Se crosslinks (disulfide, thioether) — additively, so no bond the file declares is ever removed and no coordinate is touched. `nonsolvent` does the same but skips solvent residues: on the membrane that is 67 058 fewer inferred bonds and about half the inference cost, at the price of unbonded water. `off` draws only declared bonds, reproducing the pre-inference edge list exactly. `Header.provenance` names the per-scope counts whenever inference added anything. Cost, measured on the 222 227-atom membrane: cold open 4.4 s → 5.4 s, edges 50 488 → 173 964. Takes effect when a viewer panel is (re)opened.
